base_model.name: sklearn_gb
base_model.source: EXP-009B carry-forward rule: no ranker met all criteria, so BASE is the sklearn GradientBoostingRegressor (EXP-006's frozen point-regression baseline), repository defaults, seed 0

criteria.E1_economics: under top-k dropout: annualised turnover <= 1.10 x BASE's AND the paired block-bootstrap (block 8, 10000 draws, seed 0) one-sided lower bound of the net-Sharpe difference at 10 bp, level 0.95, is > 0
criteria.O1_ordering: over evaluable folds, paired per-date Rank-IC difference (ARM - BASE) > 0 with one-sided HAC lower bound (Bartlett, 4 lags, z = 1.645) > 0
criteria.O2_consistency: IC difference > 0 in at least 4 of the 5 evaluable folds AND worst evaluable-fold IC >= BASE's - 0.005

classification.ANALYST_ORDERING_ONLY: O1 and O2 and not E1

descriptive_only: feature-importance share of the analyst block

data.analyst_construction: src/quant/features/analyst_pit.py: calendar lookbacks, strictly-earlier attach, dispersion NULL below two analysts, 45-day staleness, then within-universe rank on each date

evaluable_folds.others: reported descriptively; never enter a criterion
evaluable_folds.rule: training window contains at least 24 months of analyst history (analyst tables start 2017-10-26)

analyst_pit: truncation invariance at 2022-12-31: features from vintages <= cutoff equal the full-table features on every row <= cutoff
future-perturbation at 2022-12-31: rewriting all later vintages changes no earlier feature
strict attach: no feature is drawn from a vintage dated on or after its row
gates.base_reproduces: the BASE arm equals the reference predictions of the model it uses to 1e-9
gates.dataset_and_panel: rebuilt dataset id and returns-panel hash equal the preregistered values
gates.on_failure: BLOCKED_DATA_QUALITY: nothing is trained, no metric is computed

trials.note: one added-feature arm; BASE is a control
